rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for making a phone call, including “dial 999”.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing entering or selecting the digits rather than the call itself.

example.english: When you dial the number, don’t press the wrong digits.
example.traditional: 你記住撳號碼嗰陣唔好撳錯。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 zyu6 gam6 hou6 maa5 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 gam6 co3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a graduated gauge dial showing a measurement.

example.english: This dial shows how fast the car is going now.
example.traditional: 呢個刻度盤顯示架車而家有幾快。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hak1 dou6 pun4 hin2 si6 gaa3 ce1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 gei2 faai3

rows.note: Use this for the rotary disk on an old-style telephone used to select a number.

example.english: Old telephones used a dial to dial numbers.
example.traditional: 以前啲電話係用撥號盤撥號嘅。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 di1 din6 waa2 hai6 jung6 but6 hou6 pun4 but6 hou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the face or dial of a clock.

example.english: There are some scratches on the clock's dial, so I can't see the time clearly.
example.traditional: 個鐘面有啲花，睇唔清楚時間。
example.jyutping: go3 zung1 min6 jau5 di1 faa1 tai2 m4 cing1 co2 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this for a radio's tuning control or dial, especially when turning it to change stations.

example.english: Turn the radio dial and see if you can pick up that station.
example.traditional: 你扭下個調台掣，睇下收唔收到嗰個台。
example.jyutping: nei5 nau2 haa5 go3 tiu4 toi4 zai3 tai2 haa5 sau1 m4 sau1 dou2 go2 go3 toi4

rows.note: Use this for setting or adjusting a control, including the figurative sense of turning it up to a particular level.

example.english: Can you dial the air conditioning up a little?
example.jyutping: bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 laang5 hei3 gaau3 gou1 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Use this when the action specifically involves turning a physical knob or control.

example.english: Dial the knob until the radio comes on.
example.traditional: 要扭個掣，部收音機先會著。
example.jyutping: jiu3 nau2 go3 zai3 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 sin1 wui5 zoek6
